items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Doc Severinson is quite aware of it and loves him dearly.

ctx.x: I think he's one of the greatest first trumpet players in the business. He's been doing the Tonight Show for how many years now? And he --
I don't remember. Doc Severinson is quite aware of it and loves him dearly.
Oh, definitely. Oh, sure. He's playing with Doc's regular band. He plays first trumpet with Doc's regular band now.
